issue.title: Failed incident visual goldens show pre-NEEDS ATTENTION detail panel
issue.description:

  just test-visual -- tests/ace/tui/visual/test_ace_png_snapshots_agents_clans.py::test_failed_clan_incident_by_status_collapsed_png_snapshot tests/ace/tui/visual/test_ace_png_snapshots_agents_agent_sessions.py::test_failed_session_incident_by_status_expanded_png_snapshot

Reproduces identically with `TZ=UTC`, and reproduces with the cause-chip resize changes stashed, so it is independent of that work. The `*_80x40` goldens and both `*_needs_attention_*` panel goldens are unchanged.
